headline: Congress takes a breather heading into the week—Senate returns Tuesday for judicial confirmation showdown!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on Friday, September 18, conducting minimal business before adjourning. The chamber will reconvene Tuesday to resume consideration of Angela Veronica Colmenero's nomination to be United States District Judge for the Southern District of Texas.

onTheFloor.title: Confirmation vote on Angela Veronica Colmenero for U.S. District Judge, Southern District of Texas
onTheFloor.status: Cloture vote scheduled for 5:30 PM Tuesday

house.lastSessionSummary: The House was not in session on Friday, September 18. The chamber will reconvene Monday, September 21 in pro forma session, with no substantive floor activity scheduled.
